summary: Spark's ln, log10, log2, log(b,x) and trig of doubles run natively under per-call ulp bounds (Spark's spec number plus reference's), sin/cos/tan guarded at |x| <= 2^20; Spark default no bound; per-engine numbers move to `EngineProfile` data.
note: No D-number. pow and atan2 stay refused on Spark.
